text_block_list.text:
Having finished the GⅠ race at Fuchu, as 
we were mapping out a plan for the next 
goal, the Kikuka Sho...
Agnes Tachyon received an invitation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm. The 'Laurel Cup,' is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Laurel Cup', an exhibition race 
featuring the most highly anticipated 
Umamusume of today."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With concerts and ceremonies also planned, 
attention is gathering around the sheer 
scale of the event—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The name "Laurel Cup" was borrowed from 
the "laurel tree." In the language of 
flowers, it means "victory" and "glory"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is the grand ambition we hope 
Umamusume strive for in the "Laurel Cup."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In other words, while it is billed as an 
exhibition race, rather than being a 
so-called demonstration race—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――We are aiming for a pinnacle race that 
brings together representative Umamusume 
from each generation, rivaling the 
prestige of GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then, could you tell us the reason 
for hosting the Laurel Cup this time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Broadly speaking, by holding GⅠ-level 
races during this summer period, we aim to 
further revitalize the world of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore—though this touches on matters 
specific to Umamusume, there is a vast 
variety among them to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are many Umamusume who possess 
talent yet fail to fully display their 
strength, or lack complete faith in 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It may be a bit forceful, but I want them 
to take this chance to experience a race 
where they can unleash their full 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I firmly believe that this will lead to 
the future of these girls, and by 
extension, the entire Umamusume world—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
'The future of the Uma Musume world'――huh, 
heh! The President is thinking up strange 
things again!

On the day the invitation arrived, Agnes 
Tachyon and I were watching a live 
broadcast covering the Gekkeihai.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, just as you said, they've assembled 
quite the illustrious lineup, haven't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This is shaping up to be... a race with 
remarkably high expectations."

Although the field of runners hasn't been 
finalized, specialist magazines have 
already given it prominent coverage on 
their full-color front pages.

It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call 
this the most anticipated race in the 
Umamusume world right now.

"I'm sure it'll be a great race!" When I 
continued, Agnes Tachyon let out a sigh 
and murmured, "I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"A formidable rival is a great trigger to 
push you past your limits. It's a common 
saying, after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder. I'll sleep on it tonight.

With that said, she turned on her heel and 
left the Trainer's office.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, an empty track has its own quaint 
charm, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then—the "Laurel Cup," is it? There 
couldn't be a better stage for data 
collection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I really need to make a choice soon. Plan 
A or Plan B...!

"And so, Agnes Tachyon began running alone 
in the quiet night on the track."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(More, give me more! Faster! Faster!! 
More――!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh heh, hehehe...! I already knew it 
ever since the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What lies at the limits of the potential 
sleeping within an Umamusume's legs?! What 
is the terminal velocity this body can 
achieve?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
They are still so far away, I can't even 
see their shadow...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I say so myself, it was a fine 
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, so long as the limit can be 
witnessed, it doesn't have to be with 
these eyes of mine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(......I'll enter the Laurel Cup. ...And 
then, I'll make Plan B a success.)
—The next morning.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Trainer-kun! I have something 
to tell you. Indeed, it is good news.

"I will participate in the Laurel Cup!" 
Agnes Tachyon declared.
